text: Vietnam is a land of intricate Beauty and Rich culture the country's complex history has left its mark on the people food and their way of life no moment is ever taken for granted which is made clear about the warm and hard-working Hospitality of the Vietnamese people from the UNESCO world heritage side of Ha Long Bay to the picturesque and peaceful Rice Terraces of Sapa Northern Vietnam is sure to Captivate and Inspire come with us as we experience this beautiful country for the first time and show you how to plan the perfect trip to Northern Vietnam [Music] with a lot of stress going on at home from moving to a new apartment and changing jobs Jason and I were feeling frazzled and disconnected living in a city we sometimes get so caught up in the hustle and bustle of life that we have little time to truly appreciate the beauty and power of Mother Nature we picked Northern Vietnam as a travel destination where we could truly connect with nature and forget for a moment the stresses of our everyday life we started our trip to Vietnam by flying from Seattle to Seoul and then from Seoul over to Vietnam we arrived at 8 50 pm and headed straight to our hotel in the old quarter of Hanoi where we hit the hay early exhausted from our 19-hour travel day the next day we woke up early and enjoyed a delicious Vietnamese breakfast the complimentary breakfast at hotel chains across Vietnam is fantastic every hotel that we stayed at offered to prepare fresh Pho or other traditional Vietnamese dishes at no additional cost jumping into the bold and fresh flavors of Vietnamese cuisine with breakfast was a great way to start our day after breakfast we hopped on a bus to the small city of ninbin located just an hour and a half south of Hanoi nimbin is known as the Ha Long Bay of land as everywhere you go you're surrounded by steep Limestone Cliffs with luscious Greenery and rivers throughout [Music] upon arriving we went on a beautiful bike ride to the ancient capital of Vietnam where we stopped at a beautiful temple in honor of Vietnam's first emperor [Music] after learning more about Vietnam's ancient history we continued our bike ride through the beautiful rice fields to another Buddhist temple a fantastic way to jump straight into our travel and learn more about the history and culture of this amazing country after finishing our ride we stopped for lunch and then headed to what may have been one of the most anticipated parts of the trip Trang on [Music] Trung on is a tranquil and magical Wonderland of towering Limestone Cliffs the top we had a panoramic view of ninbin and the stunning Limestone Cliffs rivers and emerald green rice paddies that stretch as far as I can see there's even an awesome dragon on top which is a economy and the floating houses that the fishermen live in [Music] upon arriving on Kappa Island we hopped on bikes and rode five kilometers to the nearby Village the bike ride was absolutely conflicts through time it was a beautiful place to visit and provided a glimpse into what a more rural Vietnamese lifestyle may have looked like after kappa Island we had a delicious lunch and headed village we topped off the afternoon with some more kayaking [Music] after exploring we headed back to the main cruise ship to enjoy an evening relaxing and taking in the views that evening before action-packed adventure on Ha Long Bay [Music] we woke up early to more incredible views just right outside our window we were feeling sad it was our last day on how long bay being surrounded by such natural beauty felt like a dream we had to keep pausing and reminding ourselves that this was real life if you are planning a trip to Ha Long Bay we would highly recommend taking a two-night three-day cruise instead of a two-night one day cruise we would also recommend planning to visit in the fall when the visibility is best while the views are still spectacular they were a little bit muted by the springtime Haze after kayaking a bit more and enjoying our last meal on the ship we headed back to the harbor and boarded a three and a half hour bus ride back to Hanoi when we arrived in Hanoi we walked around a bit and took in the sights after our peaceful three days in halong Bay this was quite the culture shock but we thoroughly enjoyed it change truly is the seasoning of Life walking down on a bus and headed back to Hanoi for our flight the next day as we drove back we reflected on our trip in the enchanting country of Vietnam as we say travel is a privilege our trip to Vietnam broadened our perspectives and helped us learn more about how we can become the best version of ourselves we truly love feeling connected with nature refreshed and ready to tackle the big life changes that awaited us at home Vietnam surprised Us in more ways than one a country that has gone through so much hardship in the past was to our surprise so warm and welcoming this was a true highlight of the trip the food was also absolutely incredible and we have a new respect for the art form that is Vietnamese Street Food these factors combined with a stunning natural beauty everywhere throughout
